title: Animal Life Cycles
seo_title: Grade 2 Science: Animal Life Cycles Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Describe the life cycles of animals, including insects, amphibians, birds and mammals; describe how animals grow and change and how parents care for their young. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand B: Life Systems – Growth and Changes in Animals)
meta_desc: Free Grade 2 science worksheets on animal life cycles, babies and parents, and how animals grow, with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Animals are born, grow and have young.
key_sub: Some hatch from eggs; some change a lot as they grow, like frogs and butterflies.
body_html:
How to think about it

Every animal has a life cycle: born, grow, have young.

  • Birds, turtles and frogs hatch from eggs.
  • Most mammals are born alive.
  • Frogs and butterflies change a lot as they grow.
Example

What does a tadpole become?

it grows legs

Answer: a frog

Example

What is a baby deer?

it has spots

Answer: a fawn

Common mistakes

  • Thinking all baby animals look like their parents.
  • Thinking all animals hatch from eggs.
